tenderSchedule.title: Supply & Installation of CCTV cameras at BTPS
tenderSchedule.description: Covers Supply and Installation of CCTV Cameras and its equipments at BTPS which shall be on the basis of single point responsibility. completely covering the activities and services in respect of all the equipments and works specified and covered under the specifications. All required Software, hardware, accessories and any other equipments which are not included in the scope and required for successful installation are in bidder scope. Five nos of 8TB hardisks mentioned in the price schedule need to be install in to the existing 64 channel NVR for ensuring the 90 days of camera backup storage. Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of CCTV Cameras and its Equipments as per the specifications mentioned in bid document
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Systems Office BTPS Bellary

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

Tender enquiries are invited through e-procurement portal for Supply & Installation of CCTV cameras at BTPS. It shall be the responsibility of the bidder to furnish all other particulars which are necessary for due consideration of the tenders though not mentioned in the specification

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bid prices must be uploaded in e-portal and those received in any other form will not be accepted
Uploaded documents shall be accepted only after verification with the originals. The bidder shall produce the originals for verification on demand
The bidder shall quote on ITEM RATE basis duly taking into consideration of works (as per the scope of work), duties and responsibility, facilities to be provided as detailed in the bid document
Bidders are requested to visit the BTPS plant site areas for a detailed study and assessment of the work before submitting the bid through the e-portal

technicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have executed the work of Supply and Installation of CCTV cameras and its equipments in any reputed organization as a prime contractor for an amount of not less than Rs.21.18 lakhs (Exclusive of GST) in any one of the preceding FIVE years i.e from 2021-22 to 2025-26. Work done value of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level of the financial year, in which tenders are invited. The intending Bidder shall upload the work order and relevant work done/work completion certificates as a documentary proof issued by the Competent Authority. On demand original shall be produced for verification
Registration of Establishment or firm or company issued by Govt. competent authorityworks) n any one year

The Bidder should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 42.35 lakhs in any two years of the preceding FIVE financial years i.e from 2021-22 to 2025-26. The intending Bidder shall upload the Profit and Loss statement duly certified by chartered accountant as a documentary proof. On demand original shall be produced for verification. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to present price level of the financial year in which tenders are invited
